Comparison

Omarchy vs Pop!_OS

Only what each project's official site says, with a source on every line.

Reviewed 2026-10-24 · independent editorial guide

Short answer

Built on Arch Linux, the Hyprland tiling window manager and the Quickshell desktop kit. Pop!_OS: Engineered and designed in-house by System76, the US computer maker.

Side by side

OmarchyPop!_OS
MakerNot a point the Omarchy manual compares.Engineered and designed in-house by System76, the US computer maker. [system76.com]
DesktopKeyboard-driven Hyprland tiling desktop. Neovim is the default editor and Foot the default terminal. [omarchy.org]Auto-tiling: windows arrange themselves, adjustable by mouse or keyboard. [system76.com]
SecurityInstalls from an ISO, either full-disk or into free space next to another OS. Encryption is on by default. [omarchy.org]Full-disk encryption where only you hold the key. [system76.com]
PackagesSoftware comes from Arch's core, extra and multilib repos plus the Omarchy Package Repository; the AUR is optional. Install with omarchy pkg add <package>. [omarchy.org]Any tools compatible with Ubuntu can run on Pop!_OS. [system76.com]

More about Omarchy

  • Built on Arch Linux, the Hyprland tiling window manager and the Quickshell desktop kit. [omarchy.org]
  • Rolling release. New installs start on the stable channel, which follows an Omarchy Arch mirror kept one month behind the latest packages. [omarchy.org]
  • Secure Boot and/or TPM must be turned off in the BIOS to install. [omarchy.org]
  • Firewall on by default: all incoming traffic is blocked except LocalSend's port 53317, and SSH stays off until you enable it. [omarchy.org]

Sources

Omarchy facts: the Omarchy manual. Pop!_OS facts: https://system76.com/pop/. Checked 2026-10-24. This site is not affiliated with either project.
